name: Grilled Spice-Rubbed Turkey Tenderloins
notes: Preheat grill to medium. Serve with pan-roasted veggies and fresh sliced bread.

name: Sheet Pan Lemon Rosemary Chicken
notes: Crispy, juicy chicken thighs with tender baby potatoes and crisped kale.

name: Asian Chicken Lettuce Wraps
notes: Ground chicken with ginger, garlic, and water chestnuts in a hoisin-soy sauce, spooned into Bibb or Boston lettuce cups. Serve brown rice alongside for the complex carbs. Leave out the chili paste â€” not needed for flavor. Kids like assembling their own.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
notes: One-skillet meal with chicken, eggs, brown rice, bell peppers, and broccoli. Use cold/leftover brown rice for best results.

name: Chicken Stir-Fry
notes: Chicken with broccoli, mushrooms, and carrots in a savory soy-sesame sauce. Serve over brown rice.

name: Coconut-Gochujang Chicken with Broccoli
notes: Gochujang and coconut milk combine to form a rich, creamy sauce brightened with fresh ginger. Serve with broccoli and brown rice.

name: Korean Ground Turkey Rice Bowls
notes: Ground turkey in a sweet-savory gochujang glaze over rice, with shredded carrots and quick-sliced cucumber. Use brown rice. Gochujang is a chili paste â€” start with 1 tablespoon instead of 2 and taste before adding more.

name: Lemongrass Chicken Thighs with Rice Noodles
notes: Make marinade morning of. Use store-bought lemongrass paste instead of stalks (4 tbsp). Can grill or sautee. Serve with rice noodles.

name: One-pan Dumplings with Greens
notes: Use chicken dumplings, scallions, cilantro.

name: Sheet Pan Asian Stir Fry
notes: Easy chicken stir fry in a soy sauce with peppers and veggies. Serve over brown rice.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
notes: Restaurant-quality aromatic tomato-cream curry. Serve over basmati or brown rice, or with naan. Mild spice level â€” great for kids. Sub coconut milk for dairy-free.

name: Chicken Pasta Primavera
notes: Chicken breast with asparagus, peas, and a light cream sauce over pasta. Use whole wheat pasta for more fiber.

name: One-pot Pasta with Ricotta and Lemon
notes: Use whole-grain or cauliflower pasta. Cut the Parmesan and just use ricotta. Add spinach or arugula.

name: Sheet Pan Lemon Chicken with Rainbow Vegetables
notes: Chicken breasts with sweet potatoes, broccoli, and bell peppers in a lemon-Parmesan glaze. One pan, minimal cleanup. Serve as-is or over brown rice.

name: Turkey Meatballs with Marinara & Zucchini Noodles
notes: Baked turkey meatballs with homemade marinara and zucchini noodles (or regular pasta). A lighter Italian comfort food night with a different poultry. Kid-friendly.

name: Turkey Ricotta Meatballs
notes: All-purpose turkey meatballs that are light and flavorful, with a rich herb-and-garlic infused butter sauce.

name: Greek Chicken Bowls
notes: Greek-marinated chicken over turmeric rice (or quinoa) with cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, feta, and homemade tzatziki. No marinade time needed. Skip chickpea variation and avocado.

name: Greek Chicken Souvlaki
notes: Chicken breast marinated in olive oil, lemon, garlic, and oregano, then skewered and cooked 8 minutes on a grill pan. Most of the time is hands-off marinating. Serve with tzatziki, a chopped Greek salad, and whole grain pita or brown rice.

name: Shakshuka
notes: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and bell pepper sauce. Serve with whole grain pita or crusty bread for dipping. Great "breakfast for dinner" alternative to frittata, with bolder North African/Middle Eastern spicing.

name: Turkey Kofta Kebabs with Tahini Sauce
notes: Ground turkey with parsley, mint, cumin, coriander, and cinnamon, formed on skewers and broiled or grilled, with a lemon-tahini sauce. Serve with whole grain pita and a cucumber-tomato salad. Omit the red pepper flakes. No chilling step needed. Skip the hummus side.

name: Crispy Baked Chicken Tacos
notes: Shredded rotisserie chicken with taco seasoning, loaded into corn tortillas with cheese and baked until crispy. Top with lettuce, tomato, salsa (no avocado).

name: Easy Chicken Fajitas
notes: Chicken breast with bell peppers and onions in homemade seasoning. Serve with corn tortillas. Skip avocado/guacamole. Kids love assembling their own!

name: Ground Turkey Sweet Potato Skillet
notes: Southwest-spiced ground turkey with sweet potatoes and spinach. One-pan. Add sour cream and cilantro for topping. Great leftovers for lunch.
